revision_note: After-hours variant of revision 3, frozen on 2026-09-23 at 19:05 ET before its first run: identical bounds, cases, timeouts, data and stop rules; the session is 16:00-20:00 America/New_York with outsideRth on every order (IBOrderTags), today's window read from the contract's tradingHours instead of liquidHours, and use_regular_trading_hours off for the data client. plan.json (revision 3, regular session) is unchanged.

engine.adapter: Python InteractiveBrokers adapter on the official ibapi client
engine.note: Not the pinned 2.0.0rc5 destination; see README 'Why 1.231.0'.

client_ids.note: The node's data and execution clients share client id 91 (one cached adapter client per host/port/client id). 92 is the official-ibapi read-only check before and after the node.

bounds.submit_rate_note: Nautilus default risk-engine throttle (drops and denies submits beyond the rate); the run's own spacing is enforced by the harness before every order is created, so the throttle never binds.

session.note: The run is refused unless [now, now + overall_deadline_seconds] lies inside [16:00, 20:00 - close_buffer]. The pre-run check reads SPY tradingHours (kept whole); a holiday or early close narrows or closes the window, and when today's segment is missing or unparseable the run is refused (refused_liquid_hours_unavailable). After-hours liquidity is thinner: the same quote-age limit and marketable offset apply, so a stale or wide quote leaves the run incomplete rather than paying up.

data.quote_source: Nautilus quote ticks from IB tick-by-tick BidAsk (subscribe params batch_quotes=false)
data.note: Tick-by-tick BidAsk carries the IB event time (one-second resolution) and is not served as delayed data. Age is node clock plus the server-minus-local offset from the pre-run check, minus the tick's ts_event.

cases.name: accept_resting
cases.order: LIMIT BUY 1 SPY DAY at max(resting_price_floor_usd, floor_to_cent(resting_fraction_of_bid * bid))

cases.name: fill_buy
cases.order: marketable LIMIT BUY 1 SPY DAY at min(ceil_to_cent(ask + marketable_offset_usd), floor_to_cent(max_notional_per_order_usd / qty)); refused before submit if that cap is below the ask or the worst-case round trip exceeds max_roundtrip_loss_usd
cases.expect: OrderFilled for the full quantity and an open long position

cases.name: flatten
cases.order: marketable LIMIT SELL of the filled quantity DAY at max(0.01, floor_to_cent(bid - marketable_offset_usd))
cases.expect: OrderFilled for the full quantity and no open position

stop_rule: Cases run in order; the first failure, exception, timeout, deadline or signal stops the sequence.
failure_disposition: Cancel every open order of this run (re-sent at most max_cancel_attempts_per_order times, recancel_interval_seconds apart, through cancel_all_orders when an order is stuck in PENDING_CANCEL), then flatten any SPY quantity this run bought with the C4 flatten order builder (marketable limit SELL, re-priced from a fresh quote, within the remaining max_orders budget, at least flatten_retry_delay_seconds after a previous flatten order closed), then stop the node. Finishing, and the strategy's on_stop, always send a final cancel for every order of this run that is still open.

end_disposition.proof: Official-ibapi read-only check (client id 92) after the node has stopped: zero non-zero positions and zero open orders; otherwise status cleanup_required and exit 3.

receipt.provisional: Before the node is built the receipt path holds a provisional cleanup_required receipt (evidence_class native_paper, run_prefix); if that write fails the run is refused before the node connects. Only the final receipt replaces it (atomic replace).

exec_engine.note: LiveExecEngineConfig in-flight resolution is pushed past the run: after inflight_check_retries queries spaced at least inflight_check_threshold_ms apart the engine fabricates OrderRejected('UNKNOWN') for SUBMITTED or OrderCanceled for PENDING_CANCEL orders (live/execution_engine.py _resolve_inflight_order). threshold x retries must exceed overall_deadline_seconds. Queries themselves still run (venue-backed).

unconfirmed_event_policy: An OrderCanceled/OrderRejected/OrderExpired with reconciliation=True was produced by the execution engine, not by an IB status callback. It never passes a case, and while one exists cleanup submits no further flatten order; the run ends for the independent flat proof.
duplicate_event_policy: A second terminal event for an order already closed (IB reports a cancel as both error 202 and orderStatus Cancelled) is recorded as a duplicate and otherwise ignored.
stop_escalation: A stop is the graceful node.stop(). If node.run() has not returned node_stop_allowance_seconds after the stop request, or on a second or later SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP once a stop was requested, the harness cancels the kernel's remaining tasks and stops the event loop so the flat proof and receipt still run. The hard stop requests a stop and never cuts a graceful stop short. A signal or hard stop before the strategy started marks the run finished so no case starts.
